children: on Thursday that it is committing $1B over the next five years to help support artificial intelligence and quantum computing efforts in the U.S.
Other areas that will receive a boost include healthcare and energy security, Nvidia added.

As part of the initiative, Nvidia will help support the U.S. higher education research universities and make investments in boosting America's quantum leadership and provide support for the cloud service providers. The tech giant is also collaborating on the phase 2 Genesis Mission awards that were announced on Thursday at the Science: A New Golden Age event in Washington, D.C.

“President Trump’s Genesis Mission is launching a new golden age of American discovery,” said Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in a statement. “With a $1 billion investment, NVIDIA is putting advanced Super Intelligence in the hands of America’s scientists to accelerate breakthroughs in medicine, energy and materials. This is how America turns scientific leadership into industrial leadership, and innovation into jobs and opportunity for generations.”
Super Intelligence is the U.S. federal government's preferred nomenclature for artificial intelligence.
Separately at the event, Nvidia's Huang was set to be awarded with the U.S.'s top science medal from President Trump. Also receiving the award were SpaceX

title: Nvidia committing $1B to boost AI, quantum, health in the US
